config.note: CHAINED (2026-07-12): the 4 faces are one data string on one SR output. faces are listed in chain order (chain_index 0..3 = Front,Left,Back,Right); each face pixel_positions run in the chain traversal direction (pixel 0 of the quad is the front face right foot). universe/universe_start_channel are contiguous across the faces. chain_pixel_offset = pixel index of the face within the string. pixel_positions are [span_coord, y] (span_coord = z for z-spanning faces, x for x-spanning); pixel_polygons: 4 corners [[s,y],...] per pixel.
